proposal.description: The capture gate closes as soon as the CPLD asserts latch_assert, treating the CPLD's own trip into the latch as a converter that has already stopped
proposal.reason: When latch_assert rises while the converter is in S_SS or S_RUN, fault_reg[BIT_LATCH] is never set. If no other cause is live, fault_time is not stamped. latch_assert is held until reset, so every later cause is also dropped from fault_reg.
